name: io.github.winsley-jeune/agentpay
title: AgentPay
description: Agents pay for tools and subscriptions from a wallet you control, with limits and passkey approvals

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your AgentPay server, e.g. http://localhost:8787 when self-hosting

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent key (ap_agent_...) from your AgentPay dashboard; its limits and level decide what the agent may spend
